entries.name: box-func-type-value-reject#0
entries.description: A bare box whose R4 is typed 0x70 = SFunc(Int => Int) (70 01 04 04 00). Under the node's (3, 3) context the type parses (function types exist from tree v3), but a function has no data encoding: rule 1009 (CheckSerializableTypeCode), and outside a tree there is nothing to degrade, so the JVM rejects. An impl that panics on the type code (sigma-rust before 09a61b05) is red as panicked.

entries.name: box-int-value-accept#1
entries.description: A bare box whose R4 is Int 1 (04 02): the control. Round-trip identity.

entries.name: box-func-const-v2-degrade-accept#2
entries.description: A bare box whose size-flagged, segregated v2 tree has a constant of type 0x70. Below tree v3 0x70 is no type code: CheckTypeCodeV6 (rule 1018) throws a ValidationException and the tree degrades to UnparsedErgoTree. Round-trip identity.

entries.name: box-func-const-v3-degrade-accept#3
entries.description: A bare box with the same tree at v3: the function type parses, its data cannot (rule 1009), and the tree degrades too. Round-trip identity.
